+def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes: Iterable[str]) -> Set[str]:
+    """Return MIME-derived suffixes missing from the upstream file filters.
+
+    WORKAROUND: https://bugreports.qt.io/browse/QTBUG-116905
+    Affected Qt versions are > 6.2.2 and < 6.7.0.
+    """
+    if not (qtutils.version_check("6.2.3") and
+            not qtutils.version_check("6.7.0")):
+        return set()
+
+    upstream = set(upstream_mimetypes)
+    extra_suffixes = set()
+    for mime in upstream:
+        if mime.endswith("/*"):
+            extra_suffixes.update(
+                suffix for suffix, mime_type in mimetypes.types_map.items()
+                if mime_type.startswith(mime[:-1])
+            )
+        elif "/" in mime:
+            extra_suffixes.update(mimetypes.guess_all_extensions(mime))
+    return extra_suffixes - upstream
